Title: GravaStar Mercury M2 Wireless Gaming Mouse, 5 Dynamic Lightsync RGB (White)
Description: Precision in Play: 1K Hz Polling Rate for Sharp Accuracy -Equipped with a 1K Hz polling rate and 26,000 DPI, the M2 captures every nuance of your movement, translating it into precise, in-game actions. Perfect for both competitive and casual gaming, it ensures your responses are always on point, thanks to the PAW3395.
Reviews:
[{"reviewer_name": "De De", "review_title": "Mercury m2 mouse", "review_text": "Absolutely amazing. Upgrade from razer deathadder v3. Sounds amazing, looks amazing, feels amazing. Best value mouse for its price. Also comes with cable and stickers which is a nice touch. The mouse connects instantly with no setup required, had amazing response, and is build great. 10/10 mouse", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "ana sophia", "review_title": "Yes, it IS worth your money!", "review_text": "Fantastic mouse for gaming and work! Comfortable for smaller hands, and is really beautiful alongside the Mercury K1 keyboard in white. Worth the wait to have a matching set. I notice a huge difference between my ergonomic mouse and this one for responsiveness and DPI settings. As someone who has to use the scroll wheel a lot I find it really satisfying with good haptic feedback. Fully customizable button mapping and rgb settings puts the cherry on top. If you’ve been wondering whether it’s worth splashing out on along with the keyboard, DO IT! They make for such a clean setup, I’ve loved every bit of my Gravastar kit.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "William", "review_title": "Buy under $80 and you get an absolute GEM", "review_text": "Beautiful mouse.
The webby design is beautiful but on the right side for Claw and Fingertip Grips makes for a very awkward seat for the fingers, palm grip is not an issue because there are grated flat surfaces toward the front of each side that is very accommodating for the thumb and fingers but I personally like to grip with my fingertips curled around the side, fingertips sitting vertically in the middle rather than fully straight and riding horizontally along the side. This completely avoids that surface meant for fingers and relies on the webbed design for support which is a little off feeling. By no means does this make it unusable, you just have to get used to it. My ring fingertip generally makes contact with that grated support surface but my pinky sits further back and I have to set it on the skinny web part.
This does not make the mouse unusable I just believe it justifies $60 over $80, this oddity in the design applies to all of GravaStar's mice.
Overall the PAW3395 is the best widespread sensor to date, yes there are better sensors but they are not generational leaps, they're just small improvements and support gimmicks like 4k and 8k polling when there is no proven practical increase over 2K, the specs of this mouse and the quality of the wireless (and bluetooth)- are pretty unbeatable at $60, $80 I'd say if you really want the design of this mouse, go for it, but this thing is always on sale.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Silas Growden", "review_title": "Fantastic Design and Quality, but Too Small", "review_text": "I’m going to give this mouse 5 stars, even though I won’t be using it.
It is exactly what is pictured. The internal LED is very well-diffused and easy to customize with Gravastar’s software. The sensor is extremely accurate. The mouse has negligible latency in both configurations, and is very smooth across my mousepad. The buttons feel excellent, and the ergonomics are pretty good: buttons are where you need them to be without being in the way.
Why won’t I be using it then? The size. It’s too small for me. I was very sad when I gave it a try, and it just didn’t fill my hand as well as my other mouse (Razer DeathAdder V2 X).
Gravastar is a fantastic company that makes quality products with a distinct style. I love their keyboard, their chargers, and their speakers. My wife has the Sakura pink version of this mouse that matches her keyboard, and she LOVES it. So I would recommend this mouse on the basis of its quality and its style to anyone, with the caveat that it’s just not the best fit for larger hands. If you’re used to a smaller mouse like a Logitech, then maybe this would be close to what you’re used to anyway, but for me, I’m more comfortable on my DeathAdder.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Zarina", "review_title": "Great mouse!", "review_text": "I got it as a gift for my sister! She LOVED it! It works great and looks really good.
She wanted a transparent one and it is lightweight, smooth and easy to connect to the laptop.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "casey S", "review_title": "Super beautiful. Low latency. Wish it was Bigger", "review_text": "Ive been using this mouse for about a month now, so far its golding up well! The mouse is beautiful. What I love about Gravastar is their unapologetically futuristic cyberpunk designs. The look of the mouse is beautiful and is exactly what I was looking for when I searched "futuristic mouse".
As far as performance, I've had no issue with it at all. The latency is extremely low (practically non existent in my experience). Both wireless and wired feel very responsive. It's very lightweight also. I haven't used the windows app yet, but from what I've seen. You can customize the rgb a bit and program the 2 side buttons and the top one near the scroll wheel.
2 gripes:
1. The design of the mouse can make it difficult to wipe the inner part of the mouse. If it gets dusty. But I guess that's the trade off for a beautiful design. Not a deal breaker.
2. It's relatively small, I have fairly large hands. So it's easy for it to slip out of my hands when it gets sweaty. They're not abnormally large, but big enough to make my hand cramp up after an hour or 2 of playing.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Kenny", "review_title": "Ok... I like it!", "review_text": "You'll either love or hate the look of this mouse. Definitely a love for me! Glides effortlessly, ergonomics are perfect for me. Haven't tested the battery life yet, but it comes about 50% charged. This is my 1st product from this company so if it holds up, it'll be good vaule for money compared to bigger brands. You can choose to download the software or use their web app. You can changed RGB colors, adjust DPI, etc. Zero issues with tracking so far. Would recommend.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "with_teeth100", "review_title": "I will never use any other from now on", "review_text": "🔥 Review: Mercury M2 Wireless Gaming Mouse 🔥
The Mercury M2 Wireless Gaming Mouse is an absolute weapon in the hands of any serious gamer. From the moment I unboxed it, I could tell this wasn’t just another “me too” peripheral—it’s a precision tool built for dominance.
The wireless response time feels indistinguishable from wired, which is insane considering how most wireless mice still struggle to match that level of speed and accuracy. Every click lands instantly, every flick registers without delay. It’s as if the M2 is reading my mind before my fingers move.
The ergonomic design deserves a standing ovation. It fits the hand like it was carved for it—no awkward angles, no fatigue after hours of gaming. The textured side grips are a small detail, but they make a massive difference during sweaty high-pressure matches.
And the sensor performance? Ruthless. Tracking is flawless, even at absurd DPI ranges. Whether I’m micro-adjusting for a pixel-perfect headshot or whipping across a 4K screen in a split-second, the Mercury M2 never loses its nerve. It’s a beast that adapts to every playstyle.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Reaverz0r", "review_title": "Great mouse!", "review_text": "AMAZING mouse!
Only complaint is that the manual came in all chinese, but easy enough to work out! looks great, feels great, i am pleasantly surprised and highly reccomend!", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "mouse buono se usato con il cavo", "review_title": "nice", "review_text": "ottimo, funziona benissimo!", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Sergio", "review_title": "Jest super", "review_text": "Pasuje do mojej małej dłoni. Jestem zadowolony z zakupu", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Logan", "review_title": "Gravastar is amazing", "review_text": "Really nice mouse, never had any issues, holds a charge for up to 2 and a halfish days, looks really nice, has a pretty good software from what I have seen, and gravastar is amazing", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Huseyin", "review_title": "Good", "review_text": "Good", "review_rating": ""}]

Title: GravaStar Mercury M1 Pro Wireless Gaming Mouse, Lightweight Magnesium Alloy, 26,000 DPI, PAW3395DM Sensor, 5 Programmable Buttons, Support Wired/2.4GHz/BT, Up to 200 Hours Battery Life (Gradient Pink)
Description: Ergonomic Precision – Play Longer, Aim Better -- Sculpted to fit your hand naturally, the M1 Pro reduces fatigue during marathon gaming sessions. Enhanced tactile buttons deliver crisp, accurate clicks—turning every move into precise, effortless action.

[{"reviewer_name": "Diolys F.", "review_title": "One of the Best Mice I’ve Owned", "review_text": "I bought this for both work and casual gaming, and it’s been one of my favorite desk upgrades. The sensor is responsive, the clicks are crisp, and switching between Bluetooth, 2.4 GHz, and wired mode has been seamless. Battery life has also been much better than I expected.
I was hesitant about the skeleton design before buying it, but in person it looks even better. I’ve had several people ask me what mouse it is because it’s so unique. It’s definitely not just for looks—it performs just as well as it looks.
If you’re on the fence, I’d absolutely recommend it. Great build quality, excellent performance, and a design that really stands out from every other mouse on the market. BUY IT!!", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Shorty_Keeper", "review_title": "More comfortable than I thought it would be", "review_text": "I was going back and forth on getting this mouse. Gave it a go and am very pleased with it. Not exactly what I would call light weight as I have sub40g mice, but the weight is not an issue. Very nice fit and feel in my hand. Smooth, responsive and great looking design. Battery life is great too. Only thing I can say that threw me a curve was the back button is a bit proud ( protrusion) and I would accidentally hit back by mistake. Once I acclimated to the button design zero negative feedback. And that had nothing to do with the build and quality but was a me thing and not something I would justify a reduced rating. Actually like it enough I got a Gravastar Mercury X Pro and love it out of the box. The Webhub driver is nice too. 10 of 10, would buy again and recommend to a friend", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "SM", "review_title": "Great quality and unique look", "review_text": "Very impressed by the overall aesthetic and functionality of this mouse. I play a lot of games involving precise aim, and this was perfect for me. I was searching for a mouse that didn't look or feel clunky, and this design is unique and really makes a difference for me. I haven't had any issues with the DPI or lighting customization, and it feels very smooth. The lighting has different modes that you can change using the software. I use it on bluetooth alone and it always connects instantly when I turn my pc on. The charge lasts almost a week of heavy use. The quality reflects a higher-end mouse for sure.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "ina", "review_title": "decent for gaming, aesthetics, and wrist health.", "review_text": "this mouse is actually so pretty and actually decent for gaming! its lightweight which is good for ergonomics and gaming. its also a surprisingly comfortable mouse (the organic design kinda made me debate it haha but its comfy). the rgb is customizable which is awesome, and it goes well with my setup 👍 with this rgb though, it doesn’t heat up much which is ideal especially for a mouse with rgb.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Melissa", "review_title": "New favorite mouse, easy to set up and use.", "review_text": "Bought this as a gift/replacement for someone whos mouse was going out.
They absolutely loves this mouse. As in it is currently his favorite mouse (this person is tech savvy and in web dev/technology so they own quite a few mice (everything from ergonomic, 3d and trackballs)
They said this about the mouse "its lightweight and responsive and it just looks so cool" their only complaint (its minor) is that sometimes after cleaning they put the mouse back wrong and try to use it upside down. (See told ya it is minor.
The colors are vibrant enough, the design suits a cyberpunk esthetic. Mouse clicks are responsive with decent feedback (clicky)
Battery life is really good. Ive seen it get charged twice since I bought it for them. It never looses its connection to the laptop.
Another complaint (again minor) they wish is was slightly (just slightly) bigger but overall it fits comfortably in their hand (male sized hand)", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Sharlie", "review_title": "Love this Mouse", "review_text": "Teenage son is loving this mouse. I have to say we have gone thru maybe 20 for gaming. Fast response time and easy gliding on surface. Solid built mouse. Comfortable. Looks like a piece of art on your desk too", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Ajay", "review_title": "Pretty sweet mouse", "review_text": "I really like this mouse—the build quality feels great, and it offers plenty of customizable features through GravaStar’s software. I use it for everything from gaming to everyday tasks, and it performs well across the board.
It’s lightweight, and the battery life is impressive—I rarely find myself needing to recharge it. The dual connectivity options are a big plus for me. I use the USB dongle with my Windows desktop or laptop, and Bluetooth with my MacBook Air since it only has USB-C.
While there isn’t a dedicated macOS app, it hasn’t been an issue. I can adjust all my settings on my Windows machine, and since they’re saved to the mouse’s onboard memory, they carry over seamlessly when I switch to my Mac.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Kaykay", "review_title": "Its a premium mouse but not the best for gaming.", "review_text": "The quality of the product is very nice, although it's heavier then what I am use to it feels premium. Not the best gaming mouse but a very pretty one.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Michele Rubertelli", "review_title": "Il Massimo!", "review_text": "La qualità dell' M1Pro è estrema ... sia come materiali che come estetica che come funzionalità .... semplicemente il meglio sul mercato!", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Jerome", "review_title": "!!!!!Ungewöhnlich gut !!!!!! Ein Meisterwerk der Kunst", "review_text": "Ich habe mir die Gravastar Mercury M1 Pro Gaming Maus vor kurzem zugelegt und bin absolut begeistert von diesem Produkt. Als leidenschaftlicher Gamer bin ich immer auf der Suche nach hochwertigem Equipment, das meine Performance verbessert, und diese Maus hat meine Erwartungen in jeder Hinsicht übertroffen.
Design und Ergonomie:
Das futuristische Design der Gravastar Mercury M1 Pro ist ein echter Hingucker. Mit ihren scharfen Linien und dem robusten, industriellen Look hebt sie sich deutlich von anderen Mäusen auf dem Markt ab. Die Ergonomie ist hervorragend; die Maus liegt perfekt in der Hand und ist auch bei langen Gaming-Sessions unglaublich komfortabel. Die Daumenauflage und die gummierten Seiten bieten zusätzlichen Halt und Kontrolle. Diese kann man zusätzlich anbringen.
Performance und Präzision:

Diese Anpassungsmöglichkeiten sind ideal für verschiedene Spielgenres und Spielstile. Die Reaktionszeit ist unglaublich schnell, und ich habe keinerlei Verzögerung bemerkt, was besonders bei kompetitiven Spielen von entscheidendem Vorteil ist. Der 4K-Empfänger sorgt für eine blitzschnelle und zuverlässige Verbindung, was die Gesamtperformance weiter verbessert. Die Tastenanschläge sind knackig und präzise, was das Spielerlebnis noch intensiver macht.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Nina Corbet", "review_title": "Parfait", "review_text": "Parfait ! Title: Razer Basilisk V3 Customizable RGB Wired Ergonomic Gaming Mouse, Black
Description: ICONIC ERGONOMIC DESIGN WITH THUMB REST — PC gaming mouse favored by millions worldwide with a form factor that perfectly supports the hand while its buttons are optimally positioned for quick and easy access
Category: Electronics,Computers & Accessories,Computer Accessories & Peripherals,Keyboards, Mice & Accessories,Mice
Reviews:
[{"reviewer_name": "Yahia B.", "review_title": "Love the switch", "review_text": "I used the Razer Mamba Elite for many years and absolutely loved it, so I was hesitant to switch. This mouse was recommended to me as a replacement, and I have been pleasantly surprised. It feels comfortable in the hand, responds quickly, and the customizable buttons and RGB lighting are excellent. The scroll wheel is especially smooth and versatile. Overall, it has been a great change and I am very happy with it.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Amazon Customer", "review_title": "Yes! Beats the G502 Hero (which I liked) and the G502 X (by a lot)", "review_text": "Good god, what a mouse. I mean, it's not perfect; nothing is. But it's so good.
I came from years of the G502 Hero; the grips on it were wearing out. I first decided to try a G502 X, as it was supposed to be an improved version of the Hero, essentially. For $25 more than the Basilisk, it pretty much sucked in my opinion. The only thing I could imagine picking it over the Basilisk for is weight. But if you care that much about weight, there are much lighter mice on the market.
---
I'll review it as compared to the Hero (and a bit to the X), as that's what I know. They're pretty common, so maybe this will help people out if they're thinking about converting:
Initially I wasn't so sure about the grip and the main mouse buttons. The mouse buttons have a rough texture, and I found with my Hero that when my fingers were slightly tacky/damp, they would stick slightly to the surface of the buttons in the same way a clean basketball shoe does to a court (i.e., not "sticky", but grippy). I liked that. But after using it for a while, I think it's totally fine and maybe even better.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Dallas Barnes", "review_title": "One of my favorite mice and you will love it too", "review_text": "This mouse is just incredibly smooth. Even with its high weight the skates make it super easy to move around and the weight gives it control, resulting in superb aim. The material can make your hands a bit sweaty when death gripping it, but it’s very solid matte surface. You can grip test and throw this mouse across a room without it breaking. The shape this mouse has just fits right in your hand, and the rubber side grips make it super comfortable and easy to use, it’s basically great with any grip type. The skates are super glidey and quiet even when under the weight of this chunker of a mouse. It’s better for bigger hands of course, it’s harder to use with smaller hands but it’s doable. The scroll wheel is the best of any mouse, even the Logitech g502. It has a setting in the software where it can be a tactile scroll wheel when scrolling slowly, but becomes a freely spinning wheel when flicked fast. You can even switch between spinny wheel mode and tactile mode with the click of a button. I loved this mouse so much I upgraded to the wireless version, and I wasn’t sacrificing much leaving wired because the battery life was great on that one. 10/10 mouse.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "BearFire", "review_title": "This Mouse Ruined Cheap Mice for Me", "review_text": "I’ve genuinely liked using the Razer Basilisk V3. The first thing I noticed was how comfortable it felt. Some mice are fine for about 20 minutes and then they start feeling like a weirdly shaped brick. This mouse has been much better for longer use, whether I’m gaming or just clicking around online doing whatever nonsense I got distracted by.
What I like most is that it feels like someone actually thought about how a hand works. The buttons are responsive, the movement is smooth, and the scroll wheel feels so nice that it almost made reading comment sections worth it. Almost. While this mouse has not been life changing in a dramatic movie soundtrack kind of way, it has changed my expectations enough that going back to a cheaper mouse would feel like using a shopping cart with one bad wheel.
Oh, and the customization. I am not out here trying to launch a space mission from my desk, but it is nice being able to set things up in a way that actually fits how I use it. Once everything is dialed in, it just feels easy.
Overall, it has been a genuinely solid mouse and one of those upgrades you stop thinking about because it just quietly does its job well. Which, for a mouse, is honestly the dream. It just sits there, minds its business, and makes me slightly more powerful than I probably deserve.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Louis Barber", "review_title": "Great for the price.", "review_text": "The Razer Basilisk V3 is hands down one of the best gaming mice I've ever used. It's super comfy even during long gaming sessions thanks to its ergonomic design, and the customizable buttons are perfect for both gaming and getting stuff done. The RGB lighting looks awesome, and the HyperScroll wheel is surprisingly handy for switching between precise and fast scrolling.
The sensor is super accurate and responsive, and the mouse just glides across my mousepad. I also love how easy it is to customize everything through Razer Synapse. Whether I'm playing FPS games, MMOs, or just browsing, this mouse works perfectly.
If you want a top-notch gaming mouse with tons of customization and excellent comfort, the Basilisk V3 is totally worth it. Highly recommended!", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Noah Schreiber", "review_title": "Good gaming mouse and does what it needs. Just wish it would last longer.", "review_text": "To be honest they don't make mice like they used to. I remember a time where you would buy gaming mice and they would last 5 years minimum. Now a days they last a year if you are lucky. So far this mouse has worked pretty good and seems like it is holding up quite fine. I also want to point out I haven't had this for a very long time and I suspect the build quality of the mouse should last a year if this was anything like my old razor mouse.
The scroll wheel is pretty solid. I like how responsive it is. I have never seen a mouse scroll wheel quite like this. Scrolling speed is pretty good. Was able to do a lot of jagged movements and noticed the mouse handled it very well in minecraft.
Ergonomic of the mouse are probably the best part. I haven't used a non trackball mouse that felt this great in maybe ever. The programmable buttons I haven't used for anything since I literally have nothing to remotely use them for whatsoever.
RGB is decent. Not a selling point for me that is a selling point for some people I guess.
With that said I am not sure if I can recommend this just because it seems pretty good but the way gaming mice have been going I don't see this lasting more than a year. I remember a time where mice would last like a decade now they break if you look at them the wrong way. I will say the big pro to a gaming mouse is the fact it is meant for gaming. Yes you are paying a lot of money for something that will break within a year but you pretty much have no choice just because these mice have a sensor in them that is significantly way better than most mice.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Troy", "review_title": "Excellent & totally worth it.", "review_text": "Best mouse I've ever used. Every surface is comfortable to touch & adds to its controllability. The RMB & LMB are soft & responsive, and have a quick reset. Easy to hold & thumb rest allows for greater control during long use.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Michael", "review_title": "Peak Gaming Mouse Energy", "review_text": "This mouse is basically the “I’m him” of gaming mice. It’s super comfortable, the buttons feel crisp, and the 26K DPI sensor tracks like it’s reading your mind. The RGB lighting goes full rave mode (in a good way), and the HyperScroll wheel is clutch whether you’re swapping weapons or doom‑scrolling.
The 11 programmable buttons give you all the customization you could want, and the whole thing just feels premium. It’s fast, smooth, and honestly makes every other mouse feel a little mid.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "KARIM FAHMY", "review_title": "Excellent", "review_text": "Very good quality", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Michael T Brown", "review_title": "Fantastic mouse for those who like it heavy.", "review_text": "I'm an avid PC user and rarely replace my accessories. My mouse especially was hard to replace, as every top end mouse seems to get lighter and lighter. However, after using the Basilisk V3, I can safely say this mouse has been a perfect upgrade from my 2013 Deathadder. It weighs roughly the same, being on the heavier side for a mouse, and that's perfect for me. It's built great, has a fantastic braided cable which is smooth to the touch, it doesn't catch on corners like the older Razer cables, and the RGB is stellar. I really like the ring of RGB that goes around the base, and it's incredibly easy to edit in Razer Synapse.
The mouse is also extremely comfortable. I didn't expect a thumb rest to do much, but I'll honestly miss it if I ever have to upgrade.
For the price, you really can't go wrong. This mouse is incredible for its price point and well worth investing in if you like to 'feel' your mouse movements.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "uae", "review_title": "perfect", "review_text": "real razer mouse not a scam works perfectly fine and great quality.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Andrew", "review_title": "The greatest strength is it's smoothness of operation.", "review_text": "I've been using this mouse for about a month now.
It's my first gaming mouse.
It's lighter than I expected but that does not impair the use at all.
The greatest strength is it's smoothness of operation. The cursor glides smoothly with small and large gestures.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Raphael Oliveira", "review_title": "ótimo mouse", "review_text": "Mouse ergonômico com encaixe para dedão, tem textura no dedão e nas laterais para um grip melhor, é grande então dá para usar se você tem pegada "garra" ou se pega com a mão inteira, funciona em ambos.
É mais pesado que os outros mouses como li descrito em reviews de sites mas é um peso ideal, mouse leve é meio estranho, na minha opinião.
Vêm com botões de várias funcionalidades, como os 2 botões acima do dedão, assim como o a frente do dedão que serve para diminuir o dpi para jogos tipo FPS, por ex, usar com sniperscope onde você precisa fazer movimentos menores. Para MOBA não serve para nada, mas todos os botões são customizáveis com o app da razer, então dá para configurar para usar algum slot de item, ou skill, etc. O app também tem como fazer macros, e configurar o padrão das cores dos leds.
O cabo tem uma qualidade boa e longo. O scroll é bem macio, e tem um botão para trocar entre modo corrido (rola sem parar) e o scroll normal (com pulos/ticks). E o próprio scroll também serve como 2 botões extras quando vc empurra ele para os lados.", "review_rating": ""}]

Title: Logitech G PRO X2 SUPERSTRIKE Wireless Gaming Mouse - Black/White
Description: Designed With Pros, Engineered to Win: Designed alongside the world’s best esports athletes, the Logitech G PRO X2 SUPERSTRIKE wireless gaming mouse delivers the fastest, fully customizable click
Reviews:
[{"reviewer_name": "Sol", "review_title": "huge difference during long gaming sessions", "review_text": "The Logitech PRO X2 SUPERSTRIKE is easily one of the best gaming mice I’ve used. The first thing you notice is how incredibly lightweight it is—it glides effortlessly, which makes a huge difference during long gaming sessions. The responsiveness is top-tier, and the Lightspeed wireless connection feels just as fast and reliable as a wired mouse.
The build quality is excellent, with a clean, minimalist design that looks great on any setup. The clicks feel crisp and precise, and the customizable haptics add a nice touch for those who want to fine-tune their experience. Battery life is also impressive, and the USB-C charging is a welcome upgrade.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Joseanup", "review_title": "The best gaming mouse I’ve ever used", "review_text": "I’ve owned and tested many gaming mice over the years, and the Logitech G Superstrike X2 is, without question, the best one I’ve ever used. I don’t play competitively—I mostly enjoy adventure games, action titles, and other immersive experiences—but this mouse has made every gaming session more enjoyable. It combines incredible comfort, premium build quality, and features that genuinely stand out.
The biggest highlight for me is the haptic switches. They feel amazing, providing a tactile, satisfying click that makes every input feel deliberate and precise. The feedback is unlike anything I’ve experienced on another mouse, adding a level of immersion that you don’t realize you’re missing until you try it. Combined with the outstanding responsiveness, every click feels fast, consistent, and incredibly satisfying.
Another thing I absolutely love is how lightweight it is. It glides effortlessly across the mousepad and never feels fatiguing, even after hours of gaming. The shape is comfortable, the weight is perfectly balanced, and it almost feels like an extension of your hand.
The wireless connectivity has also been flawless. It’s fast, stable, and completely reliable, with no noticeable latency or dropouts. It truly delivers the freedom of wireless without any of the compromises that used to come with it.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Adnan Zilic", "review_title": "Haptic is the future for mice.", "review_text": "I gave this mouse 5 stars simply because of the haptic triggers. Ive only ever used the razer viper pro mouse and for my large hands its the only one that fits comfortably. The superstrike is a bit smaller in my hand but nothing that would make me stop using it. [{"reviewer_name": "N.", "review_title": "Overall, a great mouse. Has become my go to.", "review_text": "I got my first basilisk mouse on a Black Friday sale, and I got hooked. This is easily the most comfortable mouse I've used, the contours feel perfect and the extra button the side is well placed and feels like a natural addition.
